company.name: Recraft
company.shortDescription: Recraft is a generative AI design platform that enables designers to create and edit vector art, illustrations, icons, and 3D graphics.
company.description: Recraft is a generative AI design platform that enables professional designers, illustrators, and marketers to create high-quality visuals. The company's proprietary model, Recraft V3, allows for precise control over visual elements, including the placement and appearance of text and images, catering to the needs of designers seeking brand consistency. The platform offers features such as an AI image generator, vectorizer, photo editor, mockup generator, image upscaler, background remover, and AI eraser. Recraft's infinite canvas supports real-time collaboration, making it suitable for teams working on branding and marketing projects. The company has attracted users from various industries, including professionals from organizations like Ogilvy, HubSpot, Netflix, Asana, and Airbus.
